repairs: Replace generic Discord string-fragment convictions with actual Discord token-store/validation/export evidence.
Keep ordinary native networking, API import profiles, character reordering, clipboard permissions and archive bulk in neutral taxonomy branches.
Require hostname-to-HTTP value flow; retain real OAST beacons and reject unrelated policy strings.
Distinguish declarative extension scaffolding and structured analyzer examples from impersonation and injection.
Recognize serialized Markdown reference pages without suppressing executable siblings.
Detect post-commit patch upload combined with removal of configured Git-hook policy.
Repair file-local exclusions for decoded content and report Mach-O parse failures as analysis limitations.

validation.focused_regressions: positive and negative fixtures cover real beacons, token theft, documentation boundaries, native capability profiles, hooks and unrelated policy text
validation.full_validation: make validate passed: hostile 2831/2831, suspicious 1776/1776, notable 8553/8553, baseline 1320/1320
validation.archive_sibling_isolation: passed: reference and decoded examples clear; separate live PHP webshell remains hostile

scan_output_recovery: Interleaved concurrent JSON output was recovered using cached and individual archive reports; all 100 archives have readable results.
analysis_limitations: Protected runtime behavior remains unresolved for the samples placed in purgatory. A large MarsCode native member also exhausted structural-recovery time.

subsequent_endpoint_review.status: Blanket forensic benignness claim withdrawn; historical scan results and pool operations remain as recorded.
subsequent_endpoint_review.purgatory_means: Unresolved and potentially hostile; excluded from benign training data.
